app.name: PMToolkit
app.description: Essential calculators and tools for Product Managers

feedback.excellentDesc: ROI above 100%. This level of return allows for aggressive reinvestment and rapid product scaling.
feedback.goodDesc: Positive return within market average. Focus on operational cost optimization to increase margin.
feedback.attentionDesc: The result requires attention. Reevaluate the strategy or viability in Discovery.

roi.name: ROI Calculator
roi.description: Analyze the Return on Investment of features or products with SaaS benchmarks.

cac.name: CAC
cac.description: Calculate the acquisition cost to optimize marketing and sales investments.

ltv.name: LTV
ltv.description: Calculate the customer lifetime value to understand how much revenue each generates.

mrr.name: MRR/ARR
mrr.description: Calculate the recurring revenue of your SaaS business.

grossMargin.name: Gross Margin
grossMargin.description: Understand the basic profitability of your product after direct costs.

activationRate.name: Activation Rate
activationRate.description: Measure the percentage of users who complete the key action after signup.

churnRate.name: Churn Rate
churnRate.description: Calculate customer loss and retention rate to monitor business health.

dauMau.name: DAU/MAU
dauMau.description: Calculate the ratio of daily to monthly active users to measure engagement.

kFactor.name: K-Factor
kFactor.description: Calculate the virality factor of your product to understand organic growth.

nps.name: NPS
nps.description: Calculate NPS to measure customer loyalty and satisfaction.

csat.name: CSAT
csat.description: Calculate the satisfaction score based on direct surveys.

ttv.name: TTV
ttv.description: Calculate the average time until the customer perceives value in using the product.

taskSuccessRate.name: Task Success Rate
taskSuccessRate.description: Measure UX efficiency by seeing how many complete a task.

featureAdoption.name: Feature Adoption
featureAdoption.description: Calculate what percentage of your base adopted the new feature.

leadTime.name: Lead Time
leadTime.description: Average time from code (commit) to production deployment.

deploymentFrequency.name: Deployment Frequency
deploymentFrequency.description: Measures the constancy of value delivery to production.

changeFailureRate.name: Change Failure Rate
changeFailureRate.description: How many deploys cause bugs, incidents or rollbacks.

mttr.name: MTTR
mttr.description: Average time for the team to recover from a production incident.

about.title: About the Creator
about.experience_text: With a solid background in digital product management, I specialize in translating complex business needs into practical, scalable, and value-driven solutions. I have experience in backlog definition and prioritization, aligning business and technology teams, project follow-up, and continuous product improvement. Throughout my career, I have contributed to the evolution of digital solutions focused on operational efficiency, user experience, and strategic business results. I use both agile and traditional methodologies in project management, prioritizing initiatives based on data, impact, and business value. I have worked as a Product Owner on critical systems used by organizations such as the Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, Correios, Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo, and Sabesp, in addition to personal initiatives such as a SaaS platform for receivables reconciliation and a series of automated reports and dashboards for marketplace sellers.
about.motivation_text: In the day-to-day of Product Management, it is common to need tools that support analysis, decision-making, and quick validations. However, many of these solutions do not clearly explain the logic behind the results or provide market references that help contextualize the generated information. With this in mind, I created a web application that centralizes essential tools for Product professionals, bringing together practicality, context, and market benchmarks in a single free ecosystem designed for the community.
about.contact_text: Do you have suggestions for new tools, feedback about the platform, or would you like to exchange ideas about Product Management, technology, and innovation? I’d be happy to hear from you and connect with professionals from the community.
